adrs.title: Multi-repo over monorepo
adrs.decision: The organization maintains one repository per concern under the mastrocola-dev organization, each with focused scope, independent versioning, and per-repository access control.

adrs.title: Public site on Azure Static Web Apps with DNS as code
adrs.decision: The public site is hosted on Azure Static Web Apps with Cloudflare DNS records managed as code in Terraform.

adrs.title: Agent language, LLM integration, and RAG decoupling
adrs.decision: The agent is written in TypeScript using the Anthropic API directly, with RAG deferred and implemented in Python via MCP servers to decouple the host language from tool languages.

adrs.title: TypeScript without a build step and MCP server distribution
adrs.decision: TypeScript runs natively on Node 24 without a build step, MCP servers are not distributed as packages but run as independent processes, and shared conventions are replicated across repositories.

adrs.title: Agent-generated content lives at its source and is read at runtime
adrs.decision: The agent generates structured content in the docs repository on every pull request, the index is validated by a tree-hash check, and the site fetches the index at runtime from raw.githubusercontent.com.

adrs.title: One workload identity per repository and Key Vault as the only secret store
adrs.decision: Each repository has a user-assigned managed identity federated with GitHub OIDC, all secrets move to a single Key Vault with role-scoped access, and GitHub contains no secrets.

adrs.title: Agent runtime on Functions Flex Consumption with queue-based jobs
adrs.decision: The agent runtime uses Azure Functions Flex Consumption with three function apps coordinating through Service Bus queues, storing state in Table Storage, and protecting against abuse with Cloudflare, Turnstile, and per-IP quotas.
